proves.claim: runCommand prints one stderr line naming --level when the command line gave --route, and none when it gave --level.

cli.io-cli-main-run-command.route-prints.why: Without it, the approved --level rename would never reach seats still passing --route, or would warn every seat that already moved.

proves.claim: With --json, the stdout document and said lines are unchanged by --route; the deprecation line goes only to stderr.

cli.io-cli-main-run-command.the-deprecat.why: Without it, a script parsing --json output would break on the deprecation line.
